title: Kumbaya
about: It is printed in Rainbow AU songs, vol. A, song #137 (printed page A 27). Staff notation appears in 8notes.com — Kum Ba Yah (traditional). The tune is referenced in hymnary.org — tune KUM BA YAH (African-American spiritual, Gullah tradition).

verdict: Verdict: high confidence — machine extraction from a published MIDI of the standard tune. Check against the book's word sheet (A p.27, song #137) for the Rainbow variant if any.
